name: DIMO
rootCause: On November 7, 2025, the DIMO bridge proxy on Ethereum was exploited through a compromised deployer key, allowing the attacker to upgrade the proxy and withdraw nearly 30 million DIMO tokens. The stolen tokens were sold for around $40,000 before ownership was moved to a multisig to contain the incident. The bridge proxy contract's upgrade and emergency withdrawal authority was concentrated in a single deployer key. When this key was compromised, the attacker was able to authorize privileged operations without restriction, leading to the loss.
